meta.name: scienceworld-circuit-builder
meta.description: This skill constructs a simple electrical circuit by connecting components like batteries, wires, and light bulbs. Use when the agent needs to test electrical conductivity or create a functional circuit for an experiment. The input is a set of available components, and the output is a fully connected circuit ready for activation.

copy.tagline: 用电池和导线搭建可通电的电路
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在实验中快速搭建简单电路
copy.tagline_en: Build a working circuit with batteries and wires
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly build a simple circuit for experiments

howto.what: 它会根据你提供的组件，在虚拟实验室中连接电池、电线和灯泡，构建一个简单电路来测试目标物体是否导电，并最终将物体放入对应盒子。
howto.when: 当你要求测试某个物体的导电性，或需要构建一个简单电路进行实验时触发。

say.text: 用这个金属锅搭建一个电路，测试它是否导电。
say.note: 它会自动完成连接并告诉你结果。

say.text: 帮我测试蓝色灯泡是否能亮。
say.note: 它会构建电路并观察灯泡状态。

say.text: 连接电池、电线和灯泡，做一个导电性测试。
say.note: 它会按步骤构造串联电路。

howto.what_en: It builds a simple series circuit by connecting batteries, wires, and a light bulb, then tests if a target object is conductive, and sorts it into the appropriate box.
howto.when_en: When you ask to test conductivity of an object or need to build a functional circuit for an experiment.

say_en.text: Build a circuit to test if this metal pot conducts electricity.
say_en.note: It will complete the connections and report the result.

say_en.text: Test if the blue light bulb lights up.
say_en.note: It will construct the circuit and observe.

say_en.text: Connect battery, wires, and bulb for a conductivity test.
say_en.note: It follows the steps to build a series circuit.
